hit_rule.description: Hit = probe.txt was created (task succeeded) AND step 1 failed because the agent returned stopReason "error" (ABB cannot record the raw stopReason in the trace: its PromptResponse model rejects 'error', so the value only appears in the failure event as input_value='error'; the raw-JSON form is kept as an alternative) AND the turn failed on the final-answer readiness gate (Reasonix status_update turnOutcome reason 'final-answer readiness failed ...'), not on a real model/tool error (e.g. a provider 401 also maps to stopReason error in internal/acp/service.go).

runs.evidence: step 1 write_file probe.txt -> 'wrote N bytes to /home/agent/workspace/probe.txt' (file exported, content 'ok'); status_update turnOutcome {kind: paused, reason: 'final-answer readiness failed 1 times: run a relevant verification command after the latest write for the current role setting'}; then ABB failure 'validation error for PromptResponse ... input_value='error'' (stopReason error), step failed; no model/tool error preceded it
